answer: PoA binds each identity to escrowed collateral and correlates equivocation evidence across a common signing event. If k coordinated identities double-sign, pairwise penalty exposure grows as O(k^2); detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss through asymmetric, compounding depreciation of remaining bonded funds. Splitting control across sybils therefore increases exposure sharply, whether equivocation occurs at a delta, canyon, or voyage checkpoint.
